description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - The Custom Ordinance Order under Section 19
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an order issued under Section 19(A) of the Customs Ordinance that grants customs duty exemptions. It contains statutory authority references (Customs Ordinance, amendment laws), regulatory conditions for import duty waivers, and detailed schedules of exemptions. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than constituting a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is regulatory in nature, establishing legal exemptions from customs duties for specific projects and importers.
